name: r1030_1547_edu_kitchen
hook: Your kitchen layout is costing you steps
caption:
Is your kitchen layout costing you steps? 👀
The work triangle: fridge, sink, range. Each leg 4–9 ft, all three under 26 ft total, and nothing (like an island) cutting through it. That's the NKBA kitchen planning guideline.
Wrong layout: 32.2 ft per loop. Right layout: 16.6 ft.
Save this for your next remodel.
